entries.name: Redfur Tribe
entries.content:
The Redfur Tribe is a forest tribe of anthropomorphic squirrel folk, native to an autumnal forest known as "Red Owl Forest". Blessed from early generations with herculean genetics, the Redfur Tribe takes great pride in having tall, muscular, and well-endowed tribesfolk.
The Redfur Tribe is open to the outside, and even trades with the local townsfolk.

entries.name: Mating & Marriage
entries.content: The Redfur Tribe refers to all sex as "mating", whether for pleasure or procreation. The tribe does allow marriage between its tribesfolk and outsiders. However, in those cases, Chieftess Zasha must grant final approval for the marriage, order to maintain the desirable genetics for her people. Casual mating between outsiders and tribesfolk is allowed, as long as the intent is not procreation.
